text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's split up for now, then. We'll meet 
back here when it's time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the two of us visited the department 
store, the shops we wanted to check out 
were far apart, so we decided to split up 
for a bit.
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking alone in the department 
store for a while, I spotted a familiar 
Umamusume near the restaurant floor.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-What should I do... Uuuugh...
choice_data_list: (Yukino Bijin...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried by the anxious look on her face, I 
decided to call out to her.
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ! Flight-san's Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, well... it's kinda 
embarrassing, but I've been really curious 
about that restaurant. Though—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...It's so fancy that it's hard to walk 
in. City-san told me it was a great shop, 
so I've been curious, buttt...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a look at the shop. It has a mature 
vibe. It really might take some courage 
for a student to go in alone.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should pass after all... The way I 
am right now, there's just no way—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Yukino Bijin as she was about to 
leave, something suddenly came back to 
mind.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I think the future will be so much 
brighter if we help that person take 
action on their own♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It's too early to give up. There must be 
something Yukino Bijin can do herself.
choice_data_list: What's on your mind the most?
What's on your mind the most?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Eh?
choice_data_list: I want to hear why you feel so anxious.

Why you're feeling anxious. I want you to 
tell me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —...Huh? Umm, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Fancy shops make me kind of nervous, so I 
never really have the courage to go in 
alone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought for a moment. I don't have the 
courage to go in alone... Then—"
choice_data_list: —That's it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting—oh? Yukino-chan, 
you're here too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yes! I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Or ratherâum, uh, Flight-san, there's 
something I need to talk to you about...! 
Umâ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Would you please come to that restaurant 
with me...!?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What a wonderful invitation♪ I would 
love to join you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: ...You did it!!
...You did it!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
――? What's with the victory poses, you 
two? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, this Trainer here gave me some 
advice!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If you're nervous about going in alone, 
why not invite someone you trust?" she 
said.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Then—... Is that why you... with me?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, Yukino-chan! And to you too, 
Trainer, for giving me advice!
choice_data_list: I was able to give advice thanks to you!
I was able to give advice thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation. That spending 
time with you taught me something. And 
that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation. That spending 
time with you taught me something. And 
that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When someone is troubled, there's 
'teaching them how to solve it,' and 
'helping them become able to solve it 
themselves.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...―― To think you felt that way about 
me..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right! If you'd like, why don't the 
three of us go to the shop together? You 
too, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, if the two of you are up for it!
Yeah, if the two of you are okay with it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us went into a dining 
bar and decided to grab a meal.
choice_data_list: With you three, I feel at ease.
With you three, I feel at ease!

With you all, I'm sure you'll get to go to 
all kinds of places from now on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so glad I mustered the courage to 
invite you...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We owe our thanks to Trainer for 
giving us the opportunity♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I smiled back at the two of them. For a 
while after, the three of us enjoyed a 
lively meal together.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be so happy if I could have an 
experience like today's again♪"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everything's so stylish, I don't even know 
what's what... Flight-san, could I get 
your recommendations?
choice_data_list: Ah, I want to hear it too!
Ah, I want to hear it too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Understood. It's my first time at this 
shop, but I've got the hang of the vibe, 
so leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight placed the order splendidly, 
and we were able to enjoy a delicious meal 
without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be so happy if I could have an 
experience like today's again♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to keep going to all kinds of 
places with Yukino-chan in the future!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Really!? Absolutely! There are so 
many places I want to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With this opportunity, the bond between 
the two seemed to deepen even further."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be so happy if I could have an 
experience like today's again♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like what I'm seeing and what 
Trainer is seeing are drawing closer 
together..."
choice_data_list:
I hope we can keep learning from each 
other.

It'd be great if we could keep learning 
from each other.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want us to shine together and 
expand our possibilities. As far as we can 
go, endlessly forward—
